title: Performance after 1.4
summary: 1.4 opens the library twice as fast and exports a third faster. Memory is flat. One regression: the first launch after an update is slower, while the cache is rebuilt.

stats.label: First launch after an update
stats.hint: once, while the cache is rebuilt

sections.title: Opening the library
sections.body: Thumbnails are read from one file instead of one file each, so opening the library no longer waits on thousands of small reads. The gain is largest on the biggest libraries.

bars.title: Seconds to open, by library size

sections.title: Over the release
sections.body: Each nightly build from the branch, opening the 50,000-photo library.

sections.title: The regression
sections.body: The first launch after an update rebuilds the thumbnail cache in the new format: **9.4 s** on the 50,000-photo library, once. A fix that rebuilds it in the background is planned for 1.4.1.
